state.intent: Add an actual free Myfxbook hosted FX-community positioning view without extracting provider data or reintroducing clutter.
catalog: Current-only TradingView displays already load on demand
Gated Bluesky CommunityPanel prepared but not public because only5accounts matched and minimum10is required

facts.provider: Official Myfxbook generated Simple Outlook widget,6pairs EURUSD GBPUSD USDJPY USDCAD AUDUSD USDCHF. Script URL https://widgets.mfbcdn.net/scripts/fxOutlook.js?type=0&symbols=,1,2,3,5,11,29 ; preserve Powered by Myfxbook link and all provider data.
facts.scope: Positions of the Myfxbook FX community, not US ETF holdings or all retail investors. Hosted current display only, no saved raw data, votes or model input. Provider controls dates/delays; no current timestamp is invented.
facts.other: PredictionMarketsPicks live publication needs Enterprise key, so no predictionwidget. Bluesky raw data remains private; its panel stays hidden until a legitimate qualified aggregate is available.

constraints: No provider scripts in parent document; sandboxed child, no frame-data extraction
Explicit Load Myfxbook view action before third-party requests
No hosted frames/scripts at initial page load
Current-only display withheld entirely when historic edition selected
Keep copyright/source links and always offer direct provider fallback

placement.instructions: Choose the section arrangement for a single real hosted FX view and a possible later qualified Bluesky panel.

criteria.community_section: A fourth collapsed section titled Community & retail, with explicit FX-community descriptor. Host the Myfxbook panel here; include Bluesky only when qualified. Keep both distinct.
criteria.institution_section: Add Myfxbook as a separately labelled full-width panel within Policy, positioning & capital after institutional holdings.
criteria.price_section: Add Myfxbook below current TradingView charts within Price chart & technicals.

load_layout.instructions: Choose a restrained initial presentation before a reader explicitly loads the third-party view.

criteria.compact_prompt: Small provider/scope heading, one-sentence limitation, Load Myfxbook button and direct provider link; create the frame only afterclick and allowUnload.
criteria.fixed_empty_stage: Reserve a420px stage with centered loadbutton to maintainfullfinalheight beforeinteraction.
